notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Culling the Weak and Stitch Together from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
